Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Identifies beginning of new message and protocol version. ALWAYS FIRST FIELD IN MESSAGE. Valid values: FIX.4.2

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Message length, in bytes, forward to the [CheckSum 10] field. ALWAYS SECOND FIELD IN MESSAGE. Must be second field in message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Defines message type. ALWAYS THIRD FIELD IN MESSAGE.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify the sender in a FIX session.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (desk, trader, etc.). Participant can have this tag configured on the Exchange Participant database to enable them to use a single FIX session to send orders for different Traders/Users.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify the receiver in a FIX session.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Assigned value used to identify specific individual or unit intended to receive message. "ADMIN" reserved for administrative messages not intended for a specific user. If tag 50 is present in an incoming message, then the response will contain tag 57 which will return the same value as tag 50.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC).

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request. Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resends. If data is not available, set to same value as SendingTime. Original time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC) when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when message may be duplicate of another message sent under a different sequence number. Indicates that message may contain information that has been sent under another sequence number.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three bytes, simple checksum. ALWAYS LAST FIELD IN MESSAGE; i.e. serves, with the trailing SOH, as the end-of-message delimiter. Always defined as three characters.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: Establishes a FIX session between the participant and the Exchange.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Must be set to 0. Method of encryption.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: 0 (zero) means that no HeartBeat message will be sent. The value provided must not be less than 30 (unless using 0).

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Indicates both sides of a FIX session should reset sequence numbers.

Field.Name: MaxMessageSize
Field.Description: Can be used to specify the maximum number of bytes supported for messages received.

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Monitors the status of the communication link during periods of inactivity.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the Heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. Used only in Heartbeat message from server to client.

Message.Name: Test Request
Message.Description: Forces a Heartbeat from the opposing application.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat.

Message.Name: Resend Request
Message.Description: Requests retransmission of a range of messages.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent. If request is for a single message [BeginSeqNo 7 = EndSeqNo 16]. If request is for all messages subsequent to a particular message, [EndSeqNo 16=0].

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: FIX Protocol Error / Reject. Indicates a message that could not be processed at the session level.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message. Reference message sequence number.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The Tag number of the FIX field being referenced.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Where possible, message to explain reason for rejection.

Message.Name: Sequence Reset
Message.Description: Resets the incoming sequence number, in Gap Fill or Sequence Reset mode.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: Cannot be lower than the last [MsgSeqNum 34]. New sequence number.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Terminates a FIX session.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text string.
